Title: Request OTP with an empty phone number (boundary: empty string)
Preconditions: No preconditions required. The system should handle OTP requests for any phone number input.
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/auth/request-otp with the query parameter in testData.

Test Data: phoneNumber=
Expected Result: HTTP status code 400 (Bad Request). Response body contains an error message indicating that the phone number cannot be empty.

Title: Request OTP with a phone number of exactly 1 character (boundary: minimum length)
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/auth/request-otp with the query parameter in testData.

Test Data: phoneNumber=1
Expected Result: HTTP status code 200 (OK). Response body contains the message: 'OTP sent to your phone number'.

Title: Request OTP with a phone number at maximum allowed length (boundary: max length)
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/auth/request-otp with the query parameter in testData.

Test Data: phoneNumber=1234567890123456
Expected Result: HTTP status code 200 (OK). Response body contains the message: 'OTP sent to your phone number'.

Title: Request OTP with a phone number exceeding maximum allowed length (boundary: one above max)
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/auth/request-otp with the query parameter in testData.

Test Data: phoneNumber=12345678901234567
Expected Result: HTTP status code 400 (Bad Request). Response body contains an error message indicating that the phone number exceeds the maximum allowed length.

Title: Verify OTP with an empty phone number (boundary: empty string)
Preconditions: An OTP must have been requested and generated for a valid phone number.
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/auth/verify-otp with the payload in testData.

Test Data: {"phoneNumber": "", "otp": "123456"}
Expected Result: HTTP status code 400 (Bad Request). Response body contains an error message indicating that the phone number cannot be empty.

Preconditions: An OTP must have been requested and generated for a valid phone number.
Steps:

Test Data: {"phoneNumber": "1234567890", "otp": ""}
Expected Result: HTTP status code 400 (Bad Request). Response body contains an error message indicating that the OTP cannot be empty.

Title: Verify OTP with an expired OTP (boundary: exactly expired)
Preconditions: An OTP must have been requested and generated for phone number '1234567890' exactly 2 minutes ago.

Test Data: {"phoneNumber": "1234567890", "otp": "123456"}
Expected Result: HTTP status code 400 (Bad Request). Response body contains the message: 'Invalid or expired OTP'.

Title: Verify OTP with a non-existent phone number (boundary: invalid phone number)
Preconditions: No OTP should exist for the phone number in testData.
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/auth/verify-otp with the payload in testData.

Test Data: {"phoneNumber": "0000000000", "otp": "123456"}
Expected Result: HTTP status code 400 (Bad Request). Response body contains the message: 'Invalid or expired OTP'.

Title: Verify createdBy and updatedBy fields are populated for a new entity (boundary: initial creation)
Preconditions: A user must be authenticated and have a valid JWT token.
Steps:
1. Authenticate and obtain a JWT token for user 'testuser'. 2. Send a POST request to /api/areas with the payload in testData and the JWT token in the Authorization header. 3. Send a GET request to /api/areas/{id} where {id} is the ID returned in step 2.

Test Data: {"name": "Test Area", "description": "Test Description"}
Expected Result: HTTP status code 200 (OK) for both requests. Response body from step 3 contains the area with 'createdBy' and 'updatedBy' fields set to 'testuser'.

Title: Verify updatedBy field is updated for an existing entity (boundary: update operation)
Preconditions: An area must exist with ID 1 and a user must be authenticated with a valid JWT token for user 'testuser'.
Steps:
1. Authenticate and obtain a JWT token for user 'testuser'. 2. Send a PUT request to /api/areas/1 with the payload in testData and the JWT token in the Authorization header. 3. Send a GET request to /api/areas/1.

Test Data: {"name": "Updated Area", "description": "Updated Description"}
Expected Result: HTTP status code 200 (OK) for both requests. Response body from step 3 contains the area with 'updatedBy' field set to 'testuser' and 'createdBy' field unchanged.
